__broaden__.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (ἀπειλάων, τὰς … ἐπηπείλησε ’threats which he threatened’) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the swine · also fem. acc. pl. with ἄλλας, article-like: ’the others’ (τὰς δ’ ἄλλας ’and the other (portions)’) · also fem. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the, those’ (τὰς κούρας ’the maidens’) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the goats · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the small birds
